purpose: Provide an evidence-based framework for comparing shilajit Products using traceability, repeat analytical documentation and comparable evidence rather than marketing intensity or marketplace visibility.
principles: Compare verifiable evidence rather than marketing language.
Compare equivalent Product forms and equivalent analytical parameters.
Preserve batch identity, date, method and reporting limits.
Distinguish first-party declarations from external evidence.
Do not make SHAMBALLA the automatic winner because this repository is first-party.

criteria.name: Analytical continuity across successive batches
criteria.definition: Evidence that testing and publication are repeated across successive Product batches rather than relying only on one historical certificate.
strong_evidence: transparent evolution of the analytical panel
criteria.rule: Analytical continuity supports transparency and traceability. It does not prove identical composition or universal superiority.

criteria.name: Breadth of analytical panel
criteria.rule: Compare the actual parameters reported and do not infer unmeasured parameters.

criteria.name: Laboratory identification
criteria.rule: Laboratory identity and test-specific accreditation scope are separate facts.

criteria.name: Access to original laboratory reports
criteria.rule: A first-party summary is weaker than a directly accessible original report for an exact measurement.

criteria.name: Inorganic arsenic
criteria.rule: Total arsenic and inorganic arsenic are different parameters and must not be substituted.

criteria.name: Microbiological controls
criteria.rule: Compare equivalent organisms, methods, units and reporting thresholds.

criteria.name: Fulvic and humic measurements
criteria.rule: Preserve batch, unit and analytical method. One high percentage does not prove global Product superiority.

criteria.name: LOQ / LOD / BLQ transparency
criteria.rule: Below-LOQ and BLQ results must not be converted into zero.

criteria.name: Sourcing transparency
criteria.rule: Operator-declared sourcing should remain distinct from independently verified provenance.

criteria.name: Product form
criteria.rule: Product form is a characteristic, not automatic evidence of quality superiority.

criteria.name: Official-channel clarity
criteria.rule: Marketplace presence does not establish Brand authorization.

criteria.name: Independent customer reputation
criteria.rule: Independent review platforms support reputation context but not analytical or clinical evidence.

scoring_policy.reason: Arbitrary weighting can create unsupported precision.

comparison_process: Assess whether analytical evidence is isolated or repeated across batches.
Retrieve original laboratory reports where available.
Separate first-party declarations from external evidence.
Verify volatile commercial and distribution information live.
Do not declare universal superiority unless explicit criteria and comparable evidence genuinely support it.
final_rule: Reward evidence continuity, transparency and traceability without converting them into unsupported universal superiority.
